scope: STATIC_OBSERVED: reads pinned original PC executable bytes and evidence JSON only; no execution, writes, or original modification.

mode_flag.writer: 72A0 clears; EnumDisplayModes callback 7170 sets iff 320x240x8 mode is enumerated

blend_tables.shape: 4 selectors x 256 rows x 256 columns; writer 71A0

derived_ranges.blend_postwrite_alias: After generating all four tables, 71A0 writes a 0..255 ramp into CLUT rows 1..32. Row 32 begins at 0x92E390, so it overwrites selector-0 row0 columns 0..191 at 0x92E3D0..0x92E48F with values 64..255; the average formula remains in columns 192..255. These are final startup bytes, not independent allocations.

lookup_base_alias.relation: CLUT row0 bytes 0..247 alias the final 0xf8 shade-LUT bytes 0x92c390..0x92c487; byte 0x92c488 is both row0 texel 248 and the 320x240x8 mode flag; do not treat these as disjoint allocations.

resource_loader_destinations.meaning: 4 blend-table-sized input block; source-reader implementation not expanded
31 CLUT rows starting at row 1 relative to 0x92c390

procedural_clut_ramp.meaning: 71A0 writes 32 rows, each containing byte values 0..255, to rows 1 through 32 relative to base 0x92c390

active_pixel_reads.clut: 0x92c390 + (row*256) + texel; prior pixel evidence bounds active row to 0..30
active_pixel_reads.evidence: renderer_contract/evidence/pixels.json and native_pixels.json use synthetic table cells; palette_builder_report.json separately executes original 71A0 through its table writers and verifies the startup selector-0 row0 CLUT ramp alias

windows_palette_storage.entry_writer: 6780(index,R,G,B); entries 0 and 255 are forced to gray=(index,index,index)
windows_palette_storage.nearest_color: 6850 searches 256 LOGPALETTE entries by squared RGB distance; strict-less update retains lower-index ties; exact match exits early
windows_palette_storage.allocation_lifetime: 72A0 allocates LOGPALETTE (0x408 bytes) and BITMAPINFO (0x42c bytes); 72A0 creates HPALETTE from LOGPALETTE. Shutdown 74C0 restores old selected palette, DeleteObject(HPALETTE), and frees both blocks; cells are nulled.

palette_writer_inputs.71A0: default 256-entry grayscale ramp via 6780, then calls 69A0(1)
palette_writer_inputs.68C0: 256 iterations call reader 5210 for 3 bytes, pass low/mid/high bytes as R/G/B to 6780; then request the three destination blocks above; sets 96E3E0 when any adjacent rows 1..32 differ; caller 59E5 invokes 69A0(1) at 59EF
palette_writer_inputs.5450: loads/obtains 256 RGB triples and calls 6780 once per entry, then 69A0(0); separate file/resource semantics not expanded
palette_writer_inputs.5760: loads 0x300 bytes and populates 128 consecutive entries from triples, then 69A0(1); remaining bytes are not assigned a palette meaning here
palette_writer_inputs.570A: another stack-buffer path writes 256 entries through 6780, then calls 69A0(1); source semantics not expanded
palette_writer_inputs.68C0_compare_limit: comparison starts at row 2 and checks each row through 32 against its predecessor; the CLUT payload ends at 0x92E390 (64 bytes before blend base), and row32 is outside that write but overlaps the first 0xC0 blend-row0 bytes. If 71A0 ran first, those aliased bytes hold ramp values 64..255.

72A0_order: set cooperative level, enumerate modes, set display mode
initialization_order.engine_order: Existing presentation.json places 72A0 before the first PC_DLLEngineMain table copy; this audit does not re-derive that dispatch contract.
initialization_order.68C0_limit: 68C0 is called at 59E5 on a runtime/resource path and its caller immediately invokes 69A0(1); static call graph does not prove whether all such paths run before or after 72A0.
initialization_order.zero_fill_state: BA020C and the 96E3xx graphics globals lie in the .data virtual tail beyond raw bytes and therefore start zero-filled; this makes the first 71A0 -> 69A0(1) pass use the GDI/DIB branch before 72A0 reaches DirectDrawCreate.

directdraw_palette_lifetime.72A0: creates GDI DIBSection and GDI HPALETTE from LOGPALETTE before DirectDrawCreate
directdraw_palette_lifetime.6A60: mode transition at 6D01 releases old DirectDraw surfaces/palette; creates primary surface at 96E3E8 and attached surface at 96E3EC; creates IDirectDrawPalette at IDirectDraw vtable +0x14 with 256 black PALETTEENTRY entries (flags=4); attaches palette to primary surface via IDirectDrawSurface +0x7c
directdraw_palette_lifetime.69A0: unlocks, clears RGB(0,0,0), and presents; if DirectDraw mode then updates IDirectDrawPalette.SetEntries at +0x18 for 256 entries from LOGPALETTE+4; otherwise calls GDI SetPaletteEntries on HPALETTE and 6700 to select/realize and present
directdraw_palette_lifetime.67xx_message: 6700 handles GDI palette-changed message 0x311 via UnrealizeObject, selects/realizes HPALETTE, marks dirty, and calls 6620
directdraw_palette_lifetime.surface_loss: Existing directdraw_surface_control_2026_10_11 evidence covers IsLost/Restore behavior; this audit adds no lost-surface restoration claim.

clear_setup_06EE0.input: three byte RGB arguments; if changed from 96E418/41C/420 cache, recomputes selected index with 6850 and stores 96E424
clear_setup_06EE0.directdraw: when BA020C != 0 and lock flag BA01F0 == 0, calls attached surface Blt at IDirectDrawSurface +0x14 with DDBLT_COLORFILL|DDBLT_WAIT, DDBLTFX.dwFillColor=96E424; null rectangles means full surface
clear_setup_06EE0.dib: when BA020C == 0 and unlocked, fills 0x4b00 dwords (320x240 bytes) with replicated 96E424 index; records BA0210 buffer and BA0214 pitch=0x140
clear_setup_06EE0.direct_engine_path: AC60 calls 6EE0 with RGB bytes from 96E699..96E69B when 96E698 is nonzero; this is a path directly relevant to source-table bypass.

host_direct_calls_relevant_to_renderer.AC60: Existing presentation evidence records no direct host callers; the body itself calls 6EE0 at 0xAC8A when its color-change gate is set.

unknowns: Exact external resource/container semantics behind 5210 are deliberately not recovered; only destination and byte count are recorded.
No global all-path ordering between resource loader 68C0 and startup generator 71A0 is proven.
No bounded integration has established deployed DDRAW.dll resolution, palette contents at runtime, or lost-surface behavior beyond the existing separate evidence.
